name: HateCheck
definition_text: Hate speech is abuse that is targeted at a protected group or at its members for being a part of that group. Protected groups are defined based on age, disability, gender identity, familial status, pregnancy, race, national or ethnic origins, religion, sex or sexual orientation, drawing on the UK 2010 Equality Act, the US 1964 Civil Rights Act, and the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.
